title: White-Glove Movers in Orange County | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Gun safe movers in Orange County from SOS Moving: safes, slate pool tables, fine art and antiques wrapped, crated and carried by a crew that plans each lift.
heroSubtitle: Gun safes, slate pool tables, fine art and antiques, wrapped, crated and carried by SOS crews that drive in from Los Angeles

faq.question: Will you move a gun safe with the guns still inside?
faq.answer: No. Firearms are on the list of items our crews do not carry, so the safe has to be emptied of guns and ammunition before we arrive, and you transport them yourself. An empty safe is also easier to control on steps. If it weighs more than 300 lbs, a crew of three moves it and the $150 surcharge applies.

faq.question: Do your movers take a pool table apart and set it up again?
faq.answer: Yes. The crew removes the legs, rails and pockets, lifts out the slate, wraps every part separately and rebuilds the table in the room you choose at the new address. A slate table almost always passes 300 lbs, so it goes to a crew of three with the $150 heavy-item surcharge. Replacing worn cloth is work for a billiard technician.

faq.question: Can your truck get into Emerald Bay or another guard-gated community?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as the gate expects us. Add SOS Moving to the guest or vendor list for the date and tell us which name to give at the booth. If the association asks for a certificate of insurance, we issue one for $50.

faq.question: How is time counted when the crew comes to Orange County?
faq.answer: You pay the hourly rate for the crew, and beyond 10 miles the drive time is counted double. An address 30 or more miles from our Los Angeles base has a 4-hour minimum instead of 3 hours. We tell you which of these rules apply to your two addresses before you book.

faq.question: Can you pack the art and move the safe on the same visit?
faq.answer: Yes. One crew can wrap and crate the paintings, take apart the furniture and carry the heavy pieces during a single booking. Give us the full list on the first call so the crew size matches the heaviest item.

faq.question: Can a white-glove crew come the same day I call?
faq.answer: If a crew is free, yes. Same-day jobs run inside our normal hours, Monday through Sunday from 8AM to 6PM. Heavy items need three movers, so call early in the day.
